notes: SMB inbound — small engineering org, building ChatOps assistant for developer workflows.
Primary ask: pick a hosted model that hits code-assist + short helpdesk answers with <200ms median token latency for single-turn chats.
Customer tried self-serve: created account, uploaded a small prompt set, ran 10k tokens across Llama-2-13B, Mistral-Instruct-7B, Qwen-7B-mini.

Initial subjective findings from team: 'Mistral felt better on instruction-following for helpdesk replies; Qwen was cheaper/faster but sometimes verbose; Llama had strongest code examples but costy at scale.'
Key technical constraints: expect 1.2M tokens/mo initially, bursty traffic from CI hooks, want predictable per-token spend — target blended cost ~<$0.002/token.
Model selection questions from customer during call:
- Which Mistral/Llama/Qwen variants give best quality/cost for short-turn developer assistant?
- Any recommended quantization/throughput profile for Hosted API to lower unit costs?
- Fallback routing: prefer auto-fallback to cheaper variant if latency spike or quota — how to configure?
- Does Redwood expose latency percentiles per model variant (p50/p95) under our workload mix?

SE notes (Priya): ran a small bench — median token latency (eu-west region, gpu-backed): Mistral-Instruct-7B ~95ms, Qwen-7B-mini ~60ms, Llama-2-13B-quant ~140ms. Cost per 1k tokens (approx) — Mistral ~$0.9, Qwen-mini ~$0.4, Llama-13B ~$1.6 (hosted list price).

Suggested path for SMB: start with Mistral-Instruct-7B for fidelity, test Qwen-7B-mini for cost-sensitive flows (short system prompts), use routing policy to split by intent (code vs FAQ), enable prefix/KV caching for CI-triggered repeated prompts.
Customer quote: 'we're trying to avoid over-indexing on the biggest models — if we can get 90% of the quality at 30% of the cost, that's ideal.'
Action items from call: Priya to produce a 1-page cost/quality tradeoff matrix + quickstart snippets for Mistral vs Qwen; Jordan to loop in legal for DPA and ask infra team for SAML test account.

POC acceptance criteria (from customer): 1) median latency <150ms for typical 2-turn session, 2) blended cost < $0.002/token at projected volumes, 3) SSO test passes, 4) no PII logged in model outputs (audit).
